note: Thursday ~6:00 AM CT form build (Silo 1). Exactly 3–4 industry talking points become guided questions that ask recruiters to add their local, unique experience. Form week is keyed to Thursday's ISO week.

talking_points.stat: U.S. employers added 165,000 jobs in October, and the unemployment rate was 4.1%. Transportation and warehousing added 25,000 jobs; manufacturing added 19,000.
talking_points.prompt: Nationally, employers added 165,000 jobs in October and unemployment was 4.1%, with gains in transportation, warehousing, and manufacturing. What are you seeing locally?

talking_points.stat: 4.8 million people were working part time for economic reasons in October, up 339,000 from September.
talking_points.source_label: BLS Employment Situation, October 2026, Table A-8
talking_points.prompt: Nationally, 4.8 million people were working part time for economic reasons in October, up 339,000 from September. What are you seeing locally — are people asking you for more hours or full-time work?

talking_points.stat: As of September 30, seasonal job postings on Indeed were up about 10% from a year ago. Warehouse loading and stocking roles now make up about 9% of seasonal postings, up from 3.5% in 2019.
talking_points.source_label: Indeed Hiring Lab, Seasonal Hiring Is Off to a Fast Start (Oct 15, 2026)
talking_points.prompt: Nationally, seasonal job postings on Indeed were up about 10% from a year ago, and warehouse roles now make up about 9% of those postings. What are you seeing locally?

talking_points.stat: There were 7.5 million job openings in September (a 4.5% openings rate), little changed from August.
talking_points.prompt: Nationally, there were still 7.5 million job openings in September. What are you seeing locally — are clients moving faster on the people you send, or still sitting on candidates?
